signature_length_bytes.meaning: length in bytes of the UserOperation signature held by the relayer

time_window_suffix_bytes.meaning: length in bytes of the trailing validUntil/validAfter time-window suffix of the signature

hash_covers_suffix.meaning: whether IEntryPoint.getUserOpHash includes the trailing time-window suffix bytes in the hashed message

window_authenticated_by_signature.meaning: whether the validUntil/validAfter time window is covered by the owner's signature so a relayer cannot alter it without invalidating the signature

assumptions: The relayer holds a valid 77-byte signed UserOperation for the AtomWallet before rewriting the suffix.
The 77-byte signature layout is r || s || v || validUntil || validAfter with the last 12 bytes as the time-window suffix.
getUserOpHash excludes the signature field, so changing the last 12 bytes does not change userOpHash.

unresolved.description: Report does not give numeric validUntil/validAfter values or a concrete window, so the enforcement relation is carried by the grounded Boolean window_authenticated_by_signature rather than a numeric time comparison.

limitations: Impact is potential; no concrete executed transaction or observed loss is reported.
Whether the rewritten operation actually executes depends on EntryPoint validation and bundling not described in the report.
Only the i_window_not_enforced impact is formalized here; other listed impacts are out of scope for this plan.
